lp.hero.sub: KHOJ turns what you already know into career paths, a verified mentor and real first opportunities. You speak, in your own language.
lp.hero.note: Free for students  ·  Works on any smartphone  ·  Hindi, Marathi and English
lp.tour.label: A look inside KHOJ
lp.mock.ask: Tell us about a skill you like
lp.mock.said: I repair the sewing machine at home.
lp.problem.title: Schools teach. Markets wait. Nothing connects them.
lp.problem.body: Many learners in rural Maharashtra finish school with real skills and no route to an income. Courses, mentors, schemes and employers all exist, but as separate worlds. KHOJ brings them together, in your language.
lp.how.title: From one spoken sentence to a first income
lp.how.s1.d: Tell KHOJ about a skill you like, in Hindi, Marathi or English. You hear your words read back, and you can fix anything that is wrong.
lp.how.s2.d: Get 5 to 10 career paths. Each one has a reason it fits you, a five-step ladder, and a first-income step you can reach in about 90 days.
lp.how.s3.d: A verified mentor, a teacher or a working craftsperson, is matched to you. You see three choices and you pick one.
lp.how.s4.d: Do real assignments by text, voice or photo. Your mentor reviews every one and tells you what to fix, in your language.
lp.how.s5.d: When you finish, see your top 3 opportunities, checked against the official rules, with your mentor beside you when you apply.
lp.careers.title: Every path climbs the same five rungs
lp.careers.body: The first rung is always something free you can do this week. The last is a job, a gig or a small business of your own.
lp.careers.more: More paths are added over time
lp.voice.title: Your language, by voice
lp.voice.body: You do not need to type or read long text. Speak, listen and tap. KHOJ reads answers aloud, and if the microphone does not work you can type instead.
lp.voice.p2: Check your words before anything happens
lp.voice.p4: Safe on a shared family phone

lp.trust.title: AI proposes. Rules and people decide.
lp.trust.sub: Where trust matters most, a person or a written rule has the last word.
lp.trust.1.d: A rules engine checks official scheme rules. The answer is Eligible, Not eligible or Check with the office, with the source and date shown.
lp.trust.2.d: Careers, schemes and opportunities show where they come from and when a person last checked them. Without a source, we show no figure.
lp.trust.3.d: Mentors score every assignment against a rubric. AI may draft, but it never approves payment on its own.
lp.trust.4.d: AI never approves electrical or motor work and never certifies anyone. Risky steps stop until a mentor or expert has checked them.
lp.trust.5.d: Voice recordings are deleted after they are turned into text. No names, phone numbers or exact places go to the AI. Under 18 needs a guardian's consent.
lp.trust.6.d: Machine translations are labelled. A record that a person has not yet checked says so. Nothing is shown as more certain than it is.
lp.rules.title: Know before you apply
lp.rules.body: For every scheme and opportunity, KHOJ gives one of three answers. It never gives a maybe dressed up as a yes.
lp.rules.eligible.d: Every condition is met. You see the source and the date.
lp.rules.not.d: One condition fails, and we say which one in plain words.
lp.rules.office.d: A fact is missing or the record is old. We never guess, so we send you to the office.
lp.faq.title: Questions people ask
lp.faq.1.a: Yes, for students. A sponsor funds each cohort, and that money pays the mentors. Students pay nothing.
lp.faq.2.q: Do I need my own smartphone?
lp.faq.2.a: No. KHOJ works on a shared family phone. Each person signs in with their own mobile number and code, and signs out when they are done, so each person's account stays private.
lp.faq.3.q: Does KHOJ promise me a job?
lp.faq.3.a: No, and nobody honestly can. KHOJ shows you a route and a first-income step you can reach in about 90 days, and helps you walk it with a mentor.
lp.faq.4.a: Hindi, Marathi and English. Text that a machine translates is labelled, and mentors can see your original words beside the translation.
lp.faq.5.a: Each approved milestone releases part of the mentor's fee from the sponsor's wallet. In this prototype, payments are simulated.
lp.faq.6.a: You can still join. A parent or guardian must agree first, and young learners see paths that suit their age, such as small home-based first steps.
lp.faq.7.q: Is my voice recorded and kept?
lp.faq.7.a: No. Your recording is turned into text and then deleted. Only the text stays, and you can check it before anything is done with it.

err.photo_bad_format: That file is not a photo we can read. Use a JPEG or PNG photo.
err.photo_too_small: That photo is too small to read. Move closer and take it again.
err.photo_blurry: That photo is blurry. Hold the phone steady, fill the frame and take it again.
err.photo_dark: That photo is too dark. Take it near a window or in daylight.
err.photo_bright: That photo is too bright. Move away from the glare and take it again.
err.photo_duplicate: You already added this photo. Add a different one.
err.photo_already_used: This photo cannot be used. Take a new photo of your own proof.
err.too_many_photos: You have added the most photos we can keep for this. Remove one first.
err.review_in_progress: Your proof is being checked right now. Wait a moment, then try again.
err.photo_required: Add a photo of your proof first.
err.credential_not_found: We could not find that proof. Add it first.
err.photo_not_found: We could not find that photo.
work.title: Assignments
work.lead: Practice tasks for {career}. Do them, save your work, and send it to your mentor.
work.nopath.help: Pick a path first. Then your practice tasks appear here.
work.banner.title: You can practise now
work.banner.help: Do the tasks and save your work. A mentor reviews it once you have one. You do not need a mentor to start.
work.banner.pending.title: Waiting for your mentor's answer
work.banner.pending.help: You can keep practising. Your saved work can go to your mentor once they accept.
work.writtenIn: This task is shown in the language it was written in.
work.safety: Safety first. Practise on a training board only, or with the power off and unplugged. A photo that looks good does not mean the work is safe.
work.text.label: Your answer
work.text.help: Write what you did and what you learned. You can also speak.
work.photos.help: Up to {n} photos. Show only your work, not faces.
work.send.nomentor: You need a mentor to send this. Your work stays saved and you can send it later.
work.sent.title: With your mentor
work.sent.help: Your mentor will look at it and write back.
work.approved.title: Approved
work.returned.title: Your mentor asked for another try
work.call: Your mentor will call you to help.
work.ack.q: Did you read or hear your mentor's feedback?
work.ack.thanks: Thank you. We noted your answer.
ta.title: Assignments
ta.lead: Make sure each learner has good tasks. The AI can draft them, but only you decide what a learner sees.
ta.empty: You have no learners yet. When you accept a request, the learner appears here.
ta.draft.help: The learner cannot see this until you approve it. AI drafts are in English: edit before you approve.
ta.retire.confirm: Retire this assignment? Learners will no longer see it. Work already sent stays.
ta.writing: You are writing in {language}. Saving keeps any other language as it was.
ta.field.title: Title
ta.field.criteria: What you will score (3 to 5 checks)
rv.title: Review
rv.lead: Work waiting for you, oldest first. Score every point yourself. The AI only suggests.
rv.empty: Nothing is waiting for you. When a learner sends work, it appears here.
rv.pick: Choose a piece of work to review.
rv.safety: Approving a photo does not certify that the work is safe. A person must check any live electrical or motor work in person.
rv.voice: Spoken, and written down by the app.
rv.ai.ask: Ask the AI for a suggestion
rv.ai.hidden: This one is an audit sample. Score it on your own, without the AI.
rv.ai.note: The AI saw only the written answer, not the photos. It is a suggestion, not a decision.
rv.ai.unjudged: The AI could not judge this from the text.
rv.feedback.help: Say what was good and what to fix (at most 3 things). Plain words, in the learner's language if you can.
rv.ai.useFeedback: Use the AI's feedback as a start
rv.needAll: Score every point first. Each one needs your own score.
rv.cantApprove: Approval needs every point at 2 or more. Return it with feedback instead.
rv.needFeedback: To return it, write what the learner should fix.
rv.done.returned: Returned to the learner with your feedback.
err.mentor_required: Your mentor reviews your work. Ask a mentor first. Your work stays saved.
err.empty_work: Add some work first. Write a short answer or add a photo.
err.already_sent: Your work is with your mentor. Wait for the review.
err.not_a_draft: This work was already sent, so it cannot be changed.
err.score_every_criterion: Score every point. Each one needs its own score from 1 to 4.
err.score_below_pass: Approval needs every point at 2 or more. Return it with feedback instead.
err.feedback_required: Tell the learner what to fix. Write a short note.
err.already_reviewed: This work has already been reviewed.
err.ai_unavailable: The AI helper could not give a usable answer right now. You can write it yourself, or try again.
err.ai_draft_rejected: The AI only repeated what is already there. Try again, or write one yourself.
err.ai_hidden: This one is an audit sample. Score it yourself, without the AI.
err.too_many_assignments: This milestone already has the most assignments. Retire one first.
err.assignment_locked: Only a draft can be edited. Retire this one and write a new one.
err.assignment_changed: This assignment was just changed. Open it again.
err.mentor_only: Only the mentor can do this.
err.learner_only: Only the learner can do this.
err.assignment_not_found: We could not find that assignment.
err.submission_not_found: We could not find that work.
err.milestone_not_found: We could not find that step.
assess.saved.title: Approved proofs
assess.saved.help: Each one is saved under the skill it proves. Approved proofs cannot be changed.
assess.proof.another: This skill is saved below. Every skill needs its own proof: add one for the next skill you teach.
assess.evidence.partialLong: Some of your new proof was not approved yet. Your approved skills are safe. Fix the points below and submit again.
err.proof_locked: This proof is approved and saved. Add a new proof for another skill.
err.nothing_to_review: All your proof is already approved. Add a proof for another skill.
inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.lead: Short messages about your requests, your work and where to go next.
inbox.empty: Nothing here yet. New messages will show up here.
inbox.kind.mentor_request: A learner has asked you to be their mentor.
inbox.kind.mentor_declined: A mentor could not take your request. You can choose another.
inbox.kind.work_sent: New work is waiting for your review.
inbox.kind.review_ready.returned: Your mentor sent your work back with feedback.
inbox.kind.path_complete: You finished your path. See where to go next.
inbox.kind.mentor_helped: Your mentor helped you get ready to apply.

opp.lead: Real programmes and places that fit your path. KHOJ shows the rules; you apply on the official site.

opp.locked.help: Choose the path you like first. Then you can see places that fit it.

opp.unlock.mentor: Your mentor approves each step. You can ask for a mentor on the Mentor page.
opp.unlock.finish: Every step is approved. Finish your path to see everything, including programmes that are not open to you yet.
assign.unlock.title: More opportunities open as you finish steps
assign.unlock.help: {count} more are waiting. Each step your mentor approves opens more.
err.no_path: Pick a path to see opportunities.
err.opp_locked: Finish more steps to open this one.
opp.none: Nothing matches your path yet. Ask your mentor.
opp.notyet.help: You do not meet a rule for these right now. Some open when you are older.
